**Kind of change** (new term, rename, move, merge, split, retire, wording)

**Term** (ID and path for an existing term; proposed label for a new one)

**Parent** (ID or path)

**Title and definition**

**RepeatMasker type/subtype** (for a term that families can be assigned to)

**Families affected** (which Dfam families move, if any)
